answer.report_md:
**画出来要什么**

一个无总标题的15国小多图：每面板两条阶梯时间线、独立纵轴范围、灰底白网格、粗黑零线；共享图例置于上方，日期标签倾斜。

**定位一个值难在哪**

如“Slovak Republic—Real minimum wage—May-24”的9，需要国家、系列、时间三重键；纵轴每10一格，而5%容差仅0.45，无法稳定读准。

**不确定的**

本页未显示图号、总标题、单位、来源或注释，可能是跨页图的续页。密集月度点数及若干给定值的具体落点只能据线形估计。

worked_example.why_hard: Ten-unit ticks make 5% of 9 less than half a unit.

components.evidence: A heavy black horizontal zero line crosses every panel.
Several real-minimum-wage lines fall below the centred zero line.
Japan spans -20 to 60; Türkiye spans -200 to 800.
Bright-green nominal lines use horizontal treads and vertical risers.
One legend names both series above all fifteen country panels.
Fifteen country panels repeat the same two-line time-series design.
“Nominal minimum wage” and “Real minimum wage” sit above the panel grid.
Each panel is titled, including “Japan”, “Korea”, and “Latvia”.
All May/November date labels are rotated diagonally beneath panels.
Lines change monthly between semiannual May and November tick labels.
Every plot area has a light-grey fill with white gridlines.
Approximately 61 monthly positions × 2 series × 15 panels exceed 100 marks.
